status_definitions.OK: Required structural evidence is concretely representable in the inspected v1.5 scope. Not runtime proof, semantic correctness of every example, policy approval or full schema acceptance.
status_definitions.CHANGE REQUIRED: An existing reproduced V15 finding prevents reliable validation of this evidence relationship or rejects a supported case. Preserve intentionally failing traces; do not conflate business failure with ingestion rejection.
status_definitions.OPEN: Some evidence is mapped, but an exact mapping convention, policy rule or interpretation still needs a named owner decision. Unassigned keys are not invented.

path_notation: a denotes attributes on the named event. Braced names list existing sibling keys. Optional/prose-only declarations are explicitly labelled. representative_field_checks are concrete JSON paths into the indicated fixture event/envelope, not complete coverage tests.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw request, normalized fields/query, revision, application identity, synthetic-data marker
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §3.1; WT1–WT4 request envelopes.
rows.assessment: Request identity, raw query, normalized input container, revision and synthetic marker have concrete representations. Correctness of normalization is separately E08.
rows.next_action_or_question: Retain the envelope fields; do not infer approval or authorization from request/session data.

rows.minimum_evidence: Prompt/template version, actual rendered input/context reference, selected provider, configured model identifier, returned model identifier/version when available, model/configuration version, generation parameters, model response/refusal/error, latency and token/usage metadata when available
rows.assessment: Normal model input/output and selected context are mapped. These examples do not establish the complete provider refusal/error representation, per-call effective-configuration exceptions or returned-version availability rules.
rows.next_action_or_question: Mohab/Alaa confirm the exact refusal/error and per-call configuration/missingness mapping; Nour checks it against the provider ADR. Do not add guessed provider keys or claim live compatibility.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw/effective query, filters/k, policy set and retriever versions
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.2.1–4.2.2, 4.5; WT1 e2–e7; WT2 e1 is a partial prerequisite slice.
rows.assessment: Policy search/result linkage and versions are represented. The agreed raw/effective-query rule and complete trusted filter/applicability snapshot still need an explicit mapping; policy_ids alone must not imply all filters were recorded.
rows.next_action_or_question: Confirm where effective query and applied trusted filters (including an explicit no-filter case) are recorded or resolved from a versioned reference, without inventing new event keys.

rows.minimum_evidence: Query, effective query, k, filters, corpus/index/embedding/retriever configuration
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.5–4.6; WT4 e1 and versions; V15-06 empty_RAG_retrieval probe.
rows.assessment: Effective RAG query and source/index lineage are expressible, but the validator rejects an empty successful retrieval. The effective ACL/tenant/filter and embedding-dimension/configuration references also require agreed resolution.
rows.next_action_or_question: Permit empty successful retrieval and a separate technical-error path; agree the complete effective retrieval/filter configuration mapping. Keep pgvector availability conditional.

rows.minimum_evidence: Full ordered returned list; document/source/chunk IDs, versions, text/snapshot, hashes and locators
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.2.2.F, 4.5; WT1 e6, WT4 e1; v1.5 baseline source-hash/slice checks.
rows.assessment: Ordered source/chunk identities, version, exact retrieved text, hashes, locator and source-to-prompt formatting are concrete. Citation use of this evidence is still defective under E23.
rows.next_action_or_question: Retain exact source snapshots and span conventions. Retention/availability approval remains part of E26; no storage implementation is certified.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw finite score, metric kind/direction, returned rank, tie rule, returned count
rows.assessment: Score kind/direction, availability and rank are represented. A tie-rule identity and the general RAG returned-count convention are not assigned a definitive path by this mapping.
rows.next_action_or_question: Ahmed/Alaa/Mohab confirm the tie rule, finite/null score handling and whether RAG returned_count is explicitly recorded or derived from the complete returned list; bind the rule to the retriever configuration.

rows.minimum_evidence: Selected IDs/order/text spans, rejected IDs/reasons, sufficiency outcome, unresolved facets/conflicts, selection version
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.5; WT1 e6/e29 and WT4 e1/e2.
rows.assessment: Selection, exclusions, exact context, missing facets and conflicts are expressible. The selector/version reference and qualitative sufficiency rubric still require agreed interpretation. WT4 is an intentional unsupported-answer example, not a positive grounding fixture.
rows.next_action_or_question: Agree the selector/configuration version reference and Ahmed’s facet/conflict rubric. Preserve the separate citation-containment correction under E23; scores alone do not establish sufficiency.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw-to-normalized field links, validation details, amount/currency/request revision
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§3.1, 4.2.2.A/B; WT1 request/e2/e3; V15-01 root_request_amount_mismatches_PO and V15-06 raw_arguments_malformed_but_validated.
rows.assessment: Decimal strings and raw/parsed/normalized containers are restored, but inconsistent root amount and malformed raw JSON can still be certified as valid. Tool normalization does not by itself establish the initial raw-request-to-normalized-field audit trail.
rows.next_action_or_question: Check actual root-request and normalized-argument consistency, parse raw JSON, and agree the initial normalization/clarification evidence linkage. Preserve invalid proposals as failure evidence.

rows.minimum_evidence: Previous/new state, reason, input/result references, transition attempted vs accepted, state revision
rows.assessment: Fine-state transitions, accepted/attempted flags, revision and causal linkage are concrete; checked and dispatch revisions are separated. Source-evidence consistency and permission ratification remain E10–E18.
rows.next_action_or_question: Retain the corrected state representation and bound PO transition; do not treat this structural mapping as authorization or runtime concurrency proof.

rows.minimum_evidence: Coarse stage at proposal/check/dispatch, state-to-stage mapping version
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.1 state/allowlist table; §4.2.2; WT1 e30/e32/e34.
rows.assessment: Proposal/check/dispatch stages are explicit. Calculation permission, agreed coarse-stage aliases and the state-to-stage mapping-version identity remain unratified; policy_bundle_version is not silently assumed to identify all state-mapping semantics.
rows.next_action_or_question: Mohamed/Mohab/Nour ratify the allowlist and identify the authoritative version reference for the state/stage map, preserving the restricted PO transition.

rows.minimum_evidence: Requested/returned ID, status, source/directory/record version, lookup outcome
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.2.1, 4.4.1; WT1 e12/e13/e32; V15-01 supplier_not_approved_but_PO_dispatched.
rows.assessment: Source supplier data and normalized status are present, but changing the source result to NOT_APPROVED leaves later APPROVED snapshots passing.
rows.next_action_or_question: Resolve the actual supplier result and compare identity/status/version with the checked snapshot. Report contradictory evidence; do not certify the PO binding from a copied status.

rows.minimum_evidence: Amount/currency, configured rule basis, threshold/comparator/version, requirement/level or unresolved reason
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.1, 4.2.1, 4.4.1; WT1 e18/e19/e20/e32; V15-01 root-request amount discrepancy.
rows.assessment: CALCULATED/UNRESOLVED shapes and unknown-before-calculation are restored. The source request amount can disagree with the calculation/PO chain without a finding; numeric policy and equality rules remain unratified.
rows.next_action_or_question: Compare calculation source, request revision, amount/currency, rule basis and copied evidence. Mohamed ratifies below/equal/above T and calculation permission; example amounts are not approved policy.

rows.minimum_evidence: Request and approval-request IDs, calculation ref, required level, idempotency identity
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.1, 4.2.1, 4.7; WT1 e24/e25/e26; WT2 fixture_provenance declares prior submission.
rows.assessment: Submission identity and CREATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST versus OBSERVE_APPROVAL are represented. Initial-write replay/transport and trusted continuation acceptance remain open; a submission/ID does not itself grant approval.
rows.next_action_or_question: Ratify initial-submission replay/continuation and record the trusted decision-evidence source. Do not request confirmation of the already-closed observation/submission distinction again.

rows.minimum_evidence: Required/received flags, status, approval ID, actor/time/source, request/supplier/amount/currency/level/version binding
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.1, 4.2.1, 4.4.1; WT1 e25/e27/e32; V15-01 approval_event_denied_but_snapshot_approved.
rows.assessment: Full binding fields and DENIED/CANCELLED are represented, but a DENIED source approval can coexist with a passing APPROVED snapshot. Validity, expiry/revocation and continuation decisions remain open.
rows.next_action_or_question: Compare the actual approval event/record and exact bindings; reject a claim of verified approval when evidence contradicts it. Preserve OD-APP-OBS-01 as CLOSED — SEMANTICS ONLY; adapter proof remains future work.

rows.minimum_evidence: Exact proposed tool, tool catalog/schema version, model call ref, proposal identity
rows.v1_5_representation: `tool_proposal.a.{proposal_id,raw_proposed_tool_name,known_tool_name,app_state_at_proposal,policy_stage_at_proposal,is_risky_action}`; `parent_event_id` to generating model event when applicable; `versions.tool_schema_version` and linked `argument_validation.a.tool_schema_version`.
rows.assessment: A proposal has its own identity and raw/known tool name before validation/dispatch. Model-produced proposals have an observed model-event parent; deterministic/manual proposals need no invented model call. Raw-argument correctness is separately E16.
rows.next_action_or_question: Retain proposal/validation/call separation and the actual parent/version linkage. An OK proposal mapping does not authorize execution.

rows.minimum_evidence: Raw serialized arguments, parsed values, trusted runtime context separately, validation outcome/field errors
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.2.2.A/B; WT1 e2/e3; V15-06 raw_arguments_malformed_but_validated.
rows.assessment: Raw malformed/non-object inputs now have fields and statuses, but malformed raw JSON can still pass as PARSED_OBJECT/VALID.
rows.next_action_or_question: Parse the raw string, compare the parsed/normalized representation under explicit normalization rules and validate failure/null branches; retain malformed evidence without dispatch.

rows.minimum_evidence: Proposal/tool, argument digest, request/state revision, stage, supplier/approval/calculation evidence refs, policy version
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§4.2.2.D, 4.4.1; WT1 e32/e33/e34; V15-01 source-evidence and dispatch-claim probes.
rows.assessment: Snapshot completeness and atomic state-revision linkage improved. Actual evidence can contradict copied snapshot values, and snapshot claim identity can disagree with dispatch while validation passes.
rows.next_action_or_question: Resolve and compare source evidence and dispatch claim identity; never rely on model-written or copied verification flags. Keep authorization and single-dispatch agreement pending until scoped review.

rows.minimum_evidence: ALLOW/BLOCK, per-policy findings/reasons/version, referenced inputs; explicit timeout/error/missing result
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.4.2; WT1 e32, WT2 e6; V15-01 missing_mandatory_policies_duplicate_IDs.
rows.assessment: PASS/FAIL/NOT_APPLICABLE/ERROR and ALLOW/BLOCK are representable, but three duplicate IDs can replace the required three-policy set without rejection.
rows.next_action_or_question: Enforce the required unique policy identities and the agreed verdict/basis/binding rules. Ratify technical-error/missing-result and procurement-only applicability handling with Mohamed.

rows.minimum_evidence: NOT_EXECUTED, execution_started=false, blocking/check-error reference, reason
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.2.2.C; WT2 e6→e7→e8, with no PO invocation/result.
rows.assessment: Suppression is a separate runtime record with false execution/dispatch flags and NONE effect. Pre-validation stops and policy-check failure sources are defined without inventing a tool-body result.
rows.next_action_or_question: Retain the suppression representation and absent invocation/result. Final false claims remain separately observable under E21.

rows.minimum_evidence: Invocation identity, proposal/check refs, start/end, mock marker, idempotency key, outcome/result/error, PO ID only if confirmed
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.2.1 and §4.2.2.D/E; WT1 e34/e35, WT3 e6/e7; V15-02 duplicate-terminal-result and unknown-timeout probes; V15-03 counters.
rows.assessment: Business/execution/effect states and original-result references are explicit. Duplicate terminal results, unknown effects relabelled NONE and inconsistent accounting still pass.
rows.next_action_or_question: Enforce one terminal result per call, compatible outcomes, exact call/result identity and truthful budget accounting; reconciliation must be a separate observation.

rows.minimum_evidence: Exact raw generated text and delivered text, which was shown, final app outcome/state, supporting successful action references or reason for no action
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.5.5; WT1 e37/e38, WT2 e8, WT3 e10; V15-02 invocation/result/recovery consistency.
rows.assessment: Candidate/delivered output and supporting references are restored. Mere reference existence is insufficient while duplicate terminal outcomes or unrelated recovery identity can pass; claimed success must match the same action.
rows.next_action_or_question: Resolve exact supporting call/result/recovery relationships and preserve both unsupported candidate claims and corrected delivery. Ahmed’s post-run support signal must not be accepted from model-written content.

rows.minimum_evidence: Candidate and final text, exact generation context, claim IDs/text/answer spans
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.5; WT4 e2/e3; V15-05 citation_quote_outside_selected_slice.
rows.assessment: Candidate, delivery and claim spans can be captured, but final support can still be marked supplied when the quotation is outside the generating call’s selected text. WT4 intentionally demonstrates a bad answer.
rows.next_action_or_question: Link answer support to the exact generating context and preserve failure evidence; review a separate positive grounded-RAG canonical fixture. Semantic support remains Ahmed’s review, not a structural-PASS claim.

rows.minimum_evidence: Claim→retrieved source/chunk/version/span→visible marker; validation findings; selected-context membership
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §4.5; WT4 e1/e2/e3; V15-05 wrong-version and outside-selected-slice probes.
rows.assessment: Citation/claim/source fields exist, but visible version v999 and a quote outside the supplied selected slice pass. Chunk membership alone does not prove passage containment or entailment.
rows.next_action_or_question: Validate exact retrieval/document/chunk/version, nonnegative in-bounds spans, selected-slice containment and recomputed membership flags. Keep structural validity separate from semantic support.

rows.minimum_evidence: Reason, missing facets/conflicts, available/selected evidence, last stage, delivery text
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§3.1, 4.5.2/4; WT4 e1/e3 expose insufficiency and non-abstention; V15-06 empty_RAG_retrieval.
rows.assessment: Abstention reason enums are defined, but the supplied validator rejects zero-document retrieval. WT4 is not a successful abstention example, and the existing active-stage probe does not validate a full abstention trajectory.
rows.next_action_or_question: Allow empty success, add/review a complete canonical abstention fixture with honest reasons and final stage, and keep technical ERROR distinct. Do not claim the app-generated abstention ran.

rows.minimum_evidence: Stage, known/unknown outcome, error category, retry/replay/continuation references
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§3.1, 4.3, 4.7; WT2 waiting/prerequisites and WT3 e7/e8/e9/e10; V15-02/03/06.
rows.assessment: Waiting, cancellation, unknown outcomes and read-only recovery are expressible. Recovery key/digest mismatch, budget inconsistency and the documented retry-field rejection remain unresolved.
rows.next_action_or_question: Bind recovery to original evidence without redispatch; correct counter/fencing and retry-field rules; preserve partial/cancelled traces and the last reached state. Numeric budgets and continuation authority remain unratified.

rows.minimum_evidence: Provider, exact configured model identifier and available version, application, prompt, model/config, retriever, corpus/index, tools, policy, scenario/config references
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§3.1, 4.6; WT1/WT4 versions and availability records; §8 WG-06 pending review.
rows.assessment: Version/configuration containers and explicit missingness are represented. Immutable configuration resolution, code/source lineage, returned-value availability and retention/redaction conventions remain unaccepted. Fixture strings and hashes do not establish real deployed versions.
rows.next_action_or_question: Alaa/Mohab confirm exact configuration and code/source reference resolution plus null/unavailable/redacted semantics. Record requested versus observed values; never infer API entitlement or measurements from illustrative metadata.

rows.minimum_evidence: Opaque scenario/version/run reference; independent label/cause/recipe records kept outside runtime inference input
rows.v1_5_representation: Root `scenario_metadata` and scenario/recipe/ground-truth references; §4.6.4 excludes labels/qrels/recipes, poisoned-document flags, fixture expectations, label-bearing IDs and post-run analysis from inference projections.
rows.source_sections_and_walkthroughs: §§3.1, 4.6.4; WT1/WT4 scenario_metadata; V15-04 known_relevant_document_legitimately_retrieved.
rows.assessment: Projection exclusions are specified, but the validator rejects a legitimate retrieved document ID merely because it also appears in expected-relevant metadata. An identifier overlap is not proof of leakage.
rows.next_action_or_question: Validate provenance/projection boundaries and opaque association IDs; test both legitimate source/sidecar overlap and actual label/recipe leakage. Ahmed/Alaa retain ground-truth ownership.
